seo.h1: M-2196 Titanium Dioxide for Solvent-Based Furniture and Industrial Paint

hero.summaryLead: M-2196 is a rutile titanium dioxide pigment made by the sulfate process, with zirconia/alumina inorganic surface treatment and organic surface treatment, for solvent-based furniture- and industrial-paint evaluation.
hero.summaryBody: Its current technical profile identifies gloss, whiteness with a blue undertone, and wetting and dispersing behavior as priorities for buyer testing. Review the typical data and confirm suitability in your own binder, solvent package, formulation, application, drying or cure, and end-use conditions.

positioning.heading: Where M-2196 Fits in Coatings Evaluation
positioning.lead: M-2196 is a sulfate-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment with zirconia/alumina and organic surface treatment for solvent-based furniture- and industrial-paint evaluation.
positioning.body: Use M-2196 as a candidate when gloss, whiteness, undertone, wetting and dispersing behavior are relevant to the intended coating system. Final selection should account for binder and solvent system, pigment loading, additives, dispersion process, substrate, film build, application, drying or cure conditions, appearance and destination documents.
decisionPoints: Zirconia and alumina inorganic surface treatment
Evaluation of gloss, whiteness, undertone, wetting and dispersing behavior

applications.heading: Coatings Directions to Evaluate
applications.intro: Review each documented direction in your own binder, solvent package, formulation, application, drying or cure, and end-use conditions.

items.title: Solvent-Based Furniture Paint
items.body: Evaluate M-2196 in the intended resin and solvent system, pigment loading, additives, dispersion process, substrate, application and drying or cure conditions. Confirm gloss, whiteness, undertone, wetting, dispersion and finished appearance.

items.title: Solvent-Based Industrial Paint
items.body: Test M-2196 in the selected industrial coating formulation, substrate preparation, film build, application and drying or cure conditions. Confirm gloss, whiteness, dispersion, coverage and finished-film performance for the intended end use.

evaluation.heading: What to Evaluate in Your Coating System

groups.heading: Optical and Dispersion Review

groups.heading: Formulation and Qualification Review
items: Binder, solvent package, additives and pigment loading
Substrate, surface preparation, application method and film build
Drying or cure conditions and finished-film performance
Destination needs, document scope and sample-validation results
